data.content_ref: inline:The extracted_episodes.json (SRC_005) abstracts the review_ledger.json (SRC_002): SRC_005 is a higher-level narrative extraction that collapses the ledger's per-review findings into episode-level abstractions, trading granularity for continuity of the development timeline. Refuted if SRC_005 preserves all ledger-level detail at equal or finer granularity, or if it contains no content traceable to any review ledger entry.
